name: Prince-Solomon Boadu

headline: Transportation and supply chain researcher studying smart ports, inland waterways and sustainable freight.
status: Open to US logistics internships and research collaboration.
bio: I am a Ph.D. candidate in Transportation and Supply Chain Management at North Dakota State University and a Graduate Research Assistant, working under Dr. Ranjit Godavarthy.

My work sits between transportation research and hands-on logistics practice. Before my doctoral studies I spent more than six years in freight forwarding, fleet management and port operations in Ghana, clearing cargo through customs, planning routes, inspecting ferry vessels and training operations teams.
My research covers smart ports, sustainable supply chain solutions, inland waterway transport and maritime trade documentation.
